name: UQ Union / Clubs and Societies
description: UQ Union's public club directory covers academic, cultural, recreational and social societies. Its website also offers a newsletter about campus events and announcements.
sampleTitle: Affiliated clubs directory and newsletter sign-up
notes: This is an umbrella directory, not one club or a list of members. The page is undated. The contact page distinguishes club enquiries, general queries and commercial sponsorship requests.
participationNotes: Use individual club listings for their membership and participation rules. The Union newsletter form includes an Other option as well as student and staff.

name: Semper Floreat
description: UQ's student newspaper publishes editions and articles on campus life, culture and public affairs. Its 2026 archive includes a Women's Edition and a July issue.
notes: The homepage supplies the 31 August publication date for this edition. The newspaper's link hub provides its editorial contact and official social pages. A special women's edition does not make the entire newspaper a women-only publication.
participationNotes: The contributor expression of interest specifically addresses current UQ students. Use the editorial contact route to ask about an external story or interview rather than assuming contributor eligibility.

name: QUT Guild / Clubs and Societies
area: QUT Gardens Point and Kelvin Grove, Brisbane
description: QUT Guild's club directory provides routes to student societies, social activities and professional networks. The Guild also links its newsletter and student publication Glass.
notes: The club directory is undated. Public club contacts are available through its listings and the Guild's Clubs and Societies Officer page. Glass has its own existing directory record; it is not counted again here.
participationNotes: Check each society's published membership rules. The Guild's public link hub offers a newsletter sign-up; this does not establish a route to email individual members.

publicChannels.label: Guild social pages and newsletter links

name: QUT Music Society
description: A society for music makers and listeners, with ensembles, social events, trivia, karaoke and jam sessions. Its official website links public events and social channels.
notes: The official domain redirects to this WordPress site. The undated activities page describes a community for music makers and listeners; it is not a recorded-music submission desk or a promise of an interview.
participationNotes: The website describes ensemble participation for students and non-students, while instrument requirements vary by ensemble. Social and general enquiries have a public form. Luke's listing here is for discovery and conversation, not an offer to perform.

name: Griffith Clubs / Brisbane and Logan
area: Brisbane South, Brisbane City and Logan campuses
description: Griffith's public club listings cover academic, social, cultural, arts and recreational groups. They include society descriptions and links to individual public pages.
notes: The directory is undated. Griffith separates the Brisbane and Logan campus clubs from the Gold Coast Student Guild directory. This record is the directory route, not a count of independently contacted groups.
participationNotes: Follow each club's own listing for membership and activity details. The university clubs page publishes the clubs team's contact route.

name: Griffith Gold Coast Student Guild / Clubs
description: The Gold Coast Student Guild lists campus clubs across arts, recreation, academic interests, culture, sport and community service, with a public club browsing portal.
notes: The clubs page is undated. Gold Coast campus scope is explicit. The Guild's old Getamungstit magazine archive is not represented as a newly active publication.
participationNotes: Club membership conditions vary. The general contact page includes public contact details and a form requiring a student number; non-students should use the published general enquiry route, without inventing a student identifier.

publicChannels.label: Guild contact and official social pages

name: Griffitti
description: Griffith's SRC-supported student magazine publishes news, arts, campus reporting, humour and public affairs. Its current website includes a June 2026 feature on a West End creative event.
sampleTitle: Finding Community in the Backstreets of West End
notes: The SRC confirms Griffitti is student-led and links the current publication. The homepage supplies the sample date. Its contact page offers an editorial form and anonymous tipline. The Get Published page could not be fetched, so external contributor eligibility was not verified.
participationNotes: Ask the editors about stories, interviews or contributions. Publication is an editorial decision; the contact form's student number field is not marked required.

name: UniSC Student Guild / Clubs and Societies
area: Sunshine Coast and Moreton Bay; all UniSC campuses
description: UniSC Student Guild supports academic and non-academic clubs across its campuses and publishes public activity, club and student network information.
notes: The directory is undated and explicitly covers all UniSC campuses. The contact page distinguishes general, Moreton Bay and club enquiries. The separate Keep in Touch page could not be fetched, so no specific newsletter is asserted.
participationNotes: Use each club's public listing for its current activities and membership conditions. The Guild provides a public club enquiry route.

name: UniSQ Student Guild / Clubs and Societies
description: UniSQ Student Guild provides a public club directory and student network resources across Ipswich, Springfield and Toowoomba, alongside campus activities and volunteering.
sampleTitle: UniSQ clubs directory and club resources
notes: The directory is undated and includes a QPay club browsing portal. Ipswich is used as the local region filter; the organisation also covers Springfield and Toowoomba, as stated in the area field.
participationNotes: Membership and participation rules belong to each club. The Guild publishes a general contact form and campus office routes.

publicChannels.label: Guild contact form and campus routes

name: ScratchThat Magazine
area: QUT Kelvin Grove and Brisbane creative communities
description: QUT's student-led arts magazine publishes writing, visual art and music. Its official event profile describes print editions, web features and a fortnightly newsletter.
sampleTitle: Publisher profile and Lore edition launch listing
notes: The publisher-managed Humanitix profile links its official website and social pages. The profile is undated; 23 October is an event date rather than a verified article publication date. The main website returned an access error during research.
participationNotes: Current submission rules and eligibility for AI-generated recordings were not verified. Use the linked official social/contact route to ask the editors; a music publishing focus does not establish acceptance of this project.
